Positive control first: the same plugin run without the channel produced a traceback containing both the custody file path and the raising source line, asserted present. checks.name: Credential
checks.output: Ran 5 tests, OK, exit 0. A synthetic credential was injected three ways into the custody side: a file in the custody working directory, an environment variable forwarded to the custody process, and direct writes to fds 1 and 2 plus print/sys.stderr.write. Returned as a field name it was refused unknown_field; returned as an outcome it was refused unknown_outcome; written to the streams it reached the null device and neither the parent's fd 1, fd 2 nor any logging record contained it. Custody() raised VocabularyError for each of ORACLE_TOKEN, DB_PASSWORD, API_SECRET and PRIVATE_ROOT, so a credential-shaped forward is unrepresentable rather than discouraged.

checks.name: Identifier
checks.output: Ran 4 tests, OK, exit 0. A synthetic private identifier offered as an extra record key was refused unknown_key; offered as a 'value' member of a difference it was refused unknown_key, because the vocabulary has no value slot at all. The custody process's environment was measured from inside it: exactly AUTOMONIQUE_ORACLE_PLUGIN, HOME, PATH and LC_CTYPE, with the clean-side marker absent (LC_CTYPE is set by the child interpreter's own C-locale coercion, confirmed separately by starting a child with LANG set, which then has none). A forged Verdict holding a string equal to but not identical with a registry field was rejected by scan.ScanError, so the provenance scan is not satisfied by guessing the vocabulary.

checks.name: Log path

extra_checks.name: Stale-bytecode freshness hazard
extra_checks.output: Found while attacking, not predicted: importing the custody plugin through importlib served a cached .pyc after the source had been edited, because bytecode validity is (source mtime in whole seconds, source size) and a same-length edit inside the same second matches both. Positive control in the test asserts the ordinary machinery still answers with the OLD plugin's outcome after the edit. The runner now compiles the entry point from source bytes and the channel runs the interpreter with -B; the boundary answered with the NEW plugin's outcome and left no .pyc in the custody tree. The guarantee covers the entry point only; the plugin's own transitive imports use the ordinary machinery, which is recorded in tools/oracle/README.md.

notes: Implemented, adversarially measured, and NOT claimed as a closed gate. What was built: a release channel whose wire carries selectors rather than content, so no free-text slot exists for source, a credential, an identifier or a traceback to occupy; a custody process started with stdin/stdout/stderr on the null device and one release pipe as its only inherited descriptor; a trust transition (tools/oracle/release.py) that returns a typed Verdict for every input and never raises, rebuilding every released string from the clean side's own table; and a provenance scan that refuses any string in a verdict that is not identity-equal to a clean-side constant. Left undone and why: (1) GATE-ORACLE stays open - its fourth closing condition needs a review record or owner acceptance bound to an exact revision, and this candidate has 0 reviewers, no owner decision, and no commit; (2) BOOT-004 is not marked done, because plan/work-graph.toml is outside this worker's write authority, and gates_open is derived from that status, so no edit to plan/gates.md could close the gate honestly; (3) tools/oracle/check_boundary.py is standalone and importable with its own main() returning an exit code, but it is not wired into plan/check.py - several items share that file this run, so the integrator should wire it; (4) two residual channels are open and measured rather than closed: the custody process can write files (deployment control stated, not enforced by this code) and its wall clock is observable unless hold_release is on (on by default). No legacy source, private identifier, credential or real infrastructure name is recorded anywhere in this work; every marker used by the suite is invented for it.
